He says Europe has plenty of them and Ukrainian pilots could fly them right away, while the promised Rafales need lengthy training first. ➡️ Patriot and IRIS-T interceptors straight from Europe's own stockpiles. He insists this would be "not a donation" but a swap: Europe gives up its missiles now and gets the newer ones Kiev has on order once they're built. In other words, Europe empties its own air defences today and waits in the same long queue it's already stuck in. ➡️ Missiles to "balance" Russia.
